caption: "pokemon 30th anniversary" — 100,000+ searches this week. Swipe for 10 things most people don't know about the biggest franchise on Earth.

Why: on September 16 the card set "30th Celebration" went on sale worldwide on the same day, a first for Pokémon cards. Every card is foil, and it carries 30 different Pikachu cards, one for each year.

What most people don't know: Pokémon is estimated to be the highest-grossing media franchise in history, ahead of Star Wars and Marvel. It began as two Game Boy cartridges sold in Japan on February 27, 1996. The name is short for Pocket Monsters.
Very simply put: a children's game from 1996 out-earns every film universe ever made.
